answer: Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. The design leans on honeypot tasks with known-bad answers, slashed on a failed audit, each submission carries a fresh nonce. Each submission hangs on the knoll of a task receipt, and the juniper is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the summit of payment, so volume alone buys nothing.
